note: Version 1. Every held-out score uses a frozen version (`python -m haltere.obstacles.evaluate freeze`); the hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256. A changed file needs a new version and a new freeze; each frozen version is scored once per (predictor, fold) and every version is reported. The decision parameters of version 1 are a-priori values from the M3 governor design (reaction 0.3 s, margin 0.5 m, required distance about 6 m at 6 m/s, side hold 0.6 s, release after 0.3 s clear); they were fitted to no data, held-out or otherwise.

timing.rule: a frame's output is usable at t_wall + latency_s; decisions use the latest usable output; frames denser than rate_hz are thinned (evaluate.deployed_schedule) and a skipped frame keeps the previous decision

E1.neighbourhood_note: the projected cell only (14 px). The plan's '3x3 minimum' was the lateral study's 3 x 3 pixels at 160 x 90 (about 8 px at 448 x 252); a 3 x 3-cell window (42 px, about 15 deg) biases pred/true down by about 30 % on identical depth maps (prior B2 maps: 1.90 / 1.10 at 2-4 / 4-7 m instead of 2.65 / 1.64 with one cell; study 2.62 / 1.72), which would also make the M2 E1 gate easier. Chosen on the prior B2 maps (a baseline) before any model output existed.

prior_filter.use: reproduction of the lateral study's scale check only

E3.bearing: logged HUD ring bearing, else the telemetry velocity direction, else straight ahead

gate_opening.rule: the pass point (drone position at the pass) projects into the frame; blocked when the prediction at its cell is < blocked_ratio x its distance (the drone flew through, so the true free range is at least that distance)

E6.activation: m3_checks count 'any' episodes (LEFT, RIGHT or CENTRE: the governor acts on all three); side-only episodes (the lateral study's definition) are reported too

decision.note: frozen side rule (evaluate.decide_side): per frame, required distance D(v) = v (latency + reaction_s) + v^2 / (2 brake_mps2) + margin_m; a yaw column is clear when its free distance (min of the quantile over the elevation rows within elev_window_deg of the travel elevation, at least the nearest row; 5 deg ~ the 0.5 m corridor at D; out of view or NaN = blocked) is >= D; reference column = the ring bearing (velocity when no cue); reference clear = NONE, else the nearest clear column on the left/right of the reference = pass the blocking obstacle on its LEFT/RIGHT, none = CENTRE; hysteresis per the values below. Grid-only predictors use contract.grid_to_fan of their grid.

B1.input: store frame resized to 240x135 INTER_AREA by the estimator, its own HUD mask

B2.grid: minimum range per 14x14 cell, clipped to [0.3, 60] m

B3.calibration: one monotone (isotonic) map relative disparity -> ln range, fitted on fold training environments
B3.disparity: cell maximum of the labels teacher cache, else a 252x448 run

B4.note: per-frame affine fit to the evaluated frame's labels: ceiling only
